newsitem.title: UK: British youths jailed for rape of Japanese student.
newsitem.headline: British youths jailed for rape of Japanese student.

text.p: A gang of British youths, led by a 16-year-old, was sentenced at the Old Bailey central criminal court on Friday for brutally raping a Japanese student.
Making no effort to hide his disgust, Judge Graham Boal told the defendants from south London that their behaviour almost defied belief.
"To say you behaved like animals would do an injustice to the animal kingdom," he said.
"Rape is a traumatic experience for any woman. I strongly suspect this girl has been traumatised for life."
During her two-day ordeal, Boal said they had subjected the unnamed 20-year-old who came to Britain to study English to "degradation of the basest kind".
Gerrard Molloy, received two 10-year sentences for double rape, two-six years terms for abetting others to rape and four more years for indecent assault. The sentences will run concurrently.

His accomplices, who ranged in age from 15 to 23, received similar prison terms. The youngest assailant was jailed for 30 months while the others received three, four and six year terms for rape. A sixth teenager was jailed for indecent assault.

The court heard how Molloy invited the student to see a film after meeting her in a hamburger restaurant. Afterwards he took the unsuspecting woman to a house where he and his friends repeatedly raped and indecently assaulted her.
An English friend phoned police after the student was allowed to return to her flat.
